subject: 6x6 rigid-body mass matrix, closed block form

reference.citation: Fossen (2011) Handbook of Marine Craft Hydrodynamics and Motion Control, Sec. 3.3 'Rigid-Body Dynamics', eq. (3.44): M_RB = [[m I3, -m S(r_g)], [m S(r_g), I_b + m S(r_g)^T S(r_g)]]; solid-ellipsoid second moments I_cg = m(b^2+c^2, a^2+c^2, a^2+b^2)/5 (Lamb 1932 Ch. VI). All numbers machine-evaluated from these closed forms (solid_ellipsoid_mass_properties / rigid_body_mass_matrix); no table copied.

sign_flip.what: both off-diagonal blocks of the reference matrix negated

legacy_assembly.what: pre-m17324 hydrostatic.compute_mass_matrix formula [[m I3, -m S^T], [-m S, I_O + m S S^T]] on this body

negative_control.note: Both perturbations leave the matrix symmetric, so symmetry alone cannot detect them; only the kinetic-energy identity (or an entrywise comparison with the closed form) can.

platform_assembly.inertia_convention: inertia_about=origin (explicitly passed; matches rao.py / ice_rao.py call sites)

verdict.criterion: |ref-got|/|ref| < 3% per matrix entry on accepted levels
